description:
GitHub issue #136: https://github.com/jallum/beadwork/issues/136

Would it be possible to add a way to disable the version check that automatically creates a bead like "Update beadwork to vx.x.x"? For instance, an environment variable named `BEADWORK_DISABLE_AUTOMATIC_UPDATE_BEAD` or something like that could be detected by the application and used to disable the check. 

What do you think?
title: Allow disabling the automatic version check
